Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 13  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concludes that "The Boy Turns Man" has the older director when the data reveals otherwise. William Witney, the director of "A Strange Adventure," was born in 1915, making him older than Lyudmil Kirkov, born in 1933. This error arises from misinterpreting the numeric comparison of the directors' birth years, leading to the opposite conclusion than the data supports. The mistake is similar to the error pattern of numerical misinterpretation, where the chronological relationship is incorrectly applied or understood.
